differences.subject: playground_tower_top
differences.description: The top of the playground tower has a flag in the first panel and a ball finial in the second panel.

differences.subject: playground_tower_base
differences.description: The window at the base of the playground tower is circular in the first panel and arched in the second panel.

differences.subject: tree_foliage
differences.description: The tree foliage has flower patterns in the second panel that are absent in the first panel.

differences.subject: boy_shirt
differences.description: The boy's shirt has a star pattern in the first panel and horizontal stripes in the second panel.

differences.subject: flower_right
differences.description: The flower on the right side of the ground is a round flower in the first panel and a tulip in the second panel.

differences.subject: dog_toy
differences.description: The dog toy on the ground near the dog's feet changes from yellow in the left panel to red in the right panel.

differences.subject: small_cactus_left
differences.description: The small cactus on the far left is present in the first panel but absent in the second panel.

differences.subject: birds_in_sky
differences.description: Three birds are visible in the sky to the right of the large cactus in the second panel, but are absent in the first panel.

differences.subject: butterfly_wing_pattern
differences.description: The butterfly inside the net has a different pattern of spots on its wings.

differences.subject: cat_ears
differences.description: The cat's ears are white in the top panel and black in the bottom panel.

differences.subject: green_jacket_person_shirt
differences.description: The person in the green jacket is wearing a green shirt in the top panel and a black shirt in the bottom panel.

differences.subject: upper_planter_flowers
differences.description: The flowers in the upper planter are orange in the left panel and green in the right panel.

differences.subject: grape_near_corkscrew
differences.description: A single grape has been added near the corkscrew handle in the top right area of the board.

differences.subject: cheese_knife_handle
differences.description: The handle of the cheese knife on the right side of the board is darker in the second panel.

differences.subject: wine_glass_bottom_right
differences.description: The wine glass at the bottom right of the board contains white wine instead of red wine.

differences.subject: top_left_yellow_bead
differences.description: The small bead near the top left corner changes from yellow to green.

differences.subject: bottom_left_green_bead
differences.description: The small bead near the bottom left corner changes from green to yellow.

differences.subject: sprinkle_near_spoon
differences.description: A small blue sprinkle located to the right of the measuring spoon is missing in the right panel.

differences.subject: sprinkle_near_top_donut
differences.description: A small yellow sprinkle located above the top-left pink donut is missing in the right panel.

differences.subject: sprinkle_near_bottom_left_donut
differences.description: A small green sprinkle located near the bottom-left edge of the bottom-left pink donut is missing in the right panel.

differences.subject: beach_umbrella
differences.description: The large beach umbrella on the right side of the beach has changed from blue and white stripes to brown and white stripes.
